Suctioned_Cephalopod_Tentacles.description: Emerging from the shadows of the abyssal waters, the Suctioned Cephalopod Tentacles writhe and twist with an eerie grace, their numerous, powerful suckers capable of grasping and constricting with bone-crushing force, while their flexible bodies allow for both swift underwater propulsion and silent, creeping movement on land.

Necrotic_Shadow_Tendrils.description: The Necrotic Shadow Tendrils are ghost-like appendages that trail behind like wisps of darkness, granting their wielder the ability to glide silently through the air and infuse their touch with a chilling fear and an ethereal cold, while also increasing their speed and allowing them to become incorporeal at will.

Venomous_Stinging_Tendrils.description: The creature's ethereal tendrils pulse with a bioluminescent glow, their delicate yet deadly barbs capable of injecting a potent venom that can paralyze and ensnare unwary adventurers, while granting the entity a swift, ghostly mobility through water.
